title: cyperus variegatus
intro: Cyperus variegatus, commonly known as the umbrella sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus variegatus include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
